idea-plugin.name: Angular Removed-API Lint
idea-plugin.description:
32 checks for Angular APIs that were removed or deprecated, plus the support window on your version pin. The bundled legacy fixture — one NgModule file and its spec — returns 34 findings, 9 of them errors for removed APIs, 18 warnings and 7 advisories.

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → Angular Removed-API Lint: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. Offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/angular-removed-api-lint (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/angular-removed-api-lint

action.text: Angular Removed-API Lint: Check This File
action.description: Run Angular Removed-API Lint on the file in the editor
